程序包 org.bukkit.event

类 Event

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
直接已知子类:
AsyncPlayerPreLoginEvent, AsyncTabCompleteEvent, BlockEvent, EntityEvent, HangingEvent, InventoryEvent, InventoryMoveItemEvent, InventoryPickupItemEvent, PaintingEvent, PlayerEvent, PlayerHandshakeEvent, PlayerLeashEntityEvent, PlayerPreLoginEvent, ServerEvent, ServerExceptionEvent, ServerTickEndEvent, ServerTickStartEvent, SoundEvent, SpawnerPreSpawnEvent, TabCompleteEvent, VehicleEvent, WeatherEvent, WorldEvent
public abstract class Event extends Object
Represents an event. 表示一个事件。 All events require a static method named getHandlerList() which returns the same HandlerList as getHandlers(). 所有事件都需要一个名为 getHandlerList() 的静态方法，它返回与 getHandlers() 相同的 HandlerList。
另请参阅:
  • PluginManager.callEvent(Event)
  • PluginManager.registerEvents(Listener,Plugin)

  • 构造器详细资料

    • Event

      public Event()
      The default constructor is defined for cleaner code. This constructor assumes the event is synchronous. 定义此默认构造器是为了代码更简洁。该构造器假定事件是同步的。

    • Event

      public Event(boolean isAsync)
      This constructor is used to explicitly declare an event as synchronous or asynchronous. 此构造器用于显式声明事件是同步还是异步。
      参数:
      isAsync - true indicates the event will fire asynchronously, false by default from default constructor true 表示事件将异步触发；默认构造器默认为 false

  • 方法详细资料

    • callEvent

      public boolean callEvent()
      Calls the event and tests if cancelled. 调用事件并检测是否被取消。
      返回:
      false if event was cancelled, if cancellable. otherwise true. 若事件可取消且已被取消则为 false，否则为 true。

    • getEventName

      public String getEventName()
      Convenience method for providing a user-friendly identifier. By default, it is the event's class's simple name. 为提供用户友好的标识符而提供的便捷方法。默认为事件类的 简单名称。
      返回:
      name of this event 此事件的名称

    • isAsynchronous

      public final boolean isAsynchronous()
      Any custom event that should not by synchronized with other events must use the specific constructor. These are the caveats of using an asynchronous event: 任何不应与其他事件同步的自定义事件必须使用特定的构造器。使用异步事件需注意以下几点：
      • The event is never fired from inside code triggered by a synchronous event. Attempting to do so results in an IllegalStateException. 该事件绝不会从由同步事件触发的代码内部触发。尝试这样做会导致 IllegalStateException。
      • However, asynchronous event handlers may fire synchronous or asynchronous events 但异步事件处理器可以触发同步或异步事件
      • The event may be fired multiple times simultaneously and in any order. 该事件可能同时被多次触发，且顺序任意。
      • Any newly registered or unregistered handler is ignored after an event starts execution. 事件开始执行后，任何新注册或新注销的处理器都会被忽略。
      • The handlers for this event may block for any length of time. 此事件的事件处理器可能阻塞任意长的时间。
      • Some implementations may selectively declare a specific event use as asynchronous. This behavior should be clearly defined. 某些实现可能会有选择地将特定事件声明为异步使用。此行为应被清晰地定义。
      • Asynchronous calls are not calculated in the plugin timing system. 异步调用不计入插件计时（timings）系统。
      返回:
      false by default, true if the event fires asynchronously 默认为 false，若事件异步触发则为 true
